name: Scheduled Test Run (pytest)
description: Run a Python project’s pytest suite on a schedule and write a JUnit XML report, the Python counterpart to the npm test template. A failing test makes the run fail.

parameters.label: Tests path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the folder or file pytest should run. Python and pytest must be installed, for example with pip install pytest.

parameters.label: JUnit report path
parameters.help: Where to write the JUnit XML report. It is overwritten on every run.
